reviews.text:
Hello.
I don't have a review yet because it's closed until August 26th, I believe, but the location near Saint Lambert Park is superb.
I'm eagerly awaiting my grumpy Maine Coon's grooming appointment.

Update from August 15th: Well, no surprises, or rather, a pleasant surprise, as we were greeted by a wonderful hostess who managed to tame my grumpy cat without him getting scratched or bitten too much. I apologize again for thinking it was closed, having confused it with the sign for the neighboring shop. I believe the salon is actually closed from August 16th to September 9th.
I can only maintain the well-deserved 5 stars and my opinion of this as an exceptional cat grooming establishment. Thank you very much.

Fantastic experience!! We came because our usual groomer was on maternity leave and personally recommended Amy! We're thrilled to have discovered this safe space for small animals for grooming and makeovers. Amy is very kind and you can feel her love for animals. She did a perfect scissor cut and our little Lhasa Apso, Toupie, came out looking beautiful! She was calm and healthy when we got her back, and we'll be happy to come back for her next haircut—thank you, Amy!

I entrusted my adorable little Border Terrier to Amy. And after that first session of perfect grooming and a magnificent bath, my little Billy Boy is the most beautiful dog of the 21st century. Thank you, my friend Amy.

I was looking for a groomer for my Border Terrier and I found a wonderful person. Perfect work and service.
I highly recommend them! 👍 …

I contacted them by phone and text message, but never received a response. I followed up with another message, still nothing.

That was two months ago.

A huge thank you to Amy for her incredible work!

She's truly gifted and knows exactly how to handle cats, even the most difficult ones.
My cat had huge mats that I couldn't brush out anymore, and Amy gave him a real makeover with a gentle and tailored trim. You can tell she loves animals and is very professional.
I wholeheartedly recommend Amy to all cat owners. A thousand thanks again, dear Amy! 😻😻😻
R- Douchka 😻

Best groomer in Paris! She has endless patience with my very timid dog, and is meticulous about details, always delivering top-notch results! I've been a client for 3 years and I definitely plan to continue with Amy.

Overall, the grooming at Amy Grooming was well done: a neat cut and a satisfying aesthetic result.

However, one important point was overlooked: the hair around the foreskin was cut much too short, without my consent.

Since then, my dog ​​urinates on his paws every time he goes out, because this hair also helps guide the stream.

It's a minor detail, but with real-world consequences. More attention to this area (or simply communicating with me) would have prevented this problem.

It's a shame, because the rest of the grooming was excellent.

I highly recommend this pet grooming salon!

The owner is extremely patient and loving towards small animals; he takes excellent care of them.
His grooming technique is simply superb, top-notch.
A truly wonderful salon; I am completely satisfied!

Perfect!
First grooming appointment for our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, the result was impeccable, thank you so much!

First visit to Amy Grooming yesterday for my little Miro, and everything was perfect! 😍🥰
After a long search in Paris following the closure of our usual groomer, I'm thrilled to have found Amy.
Professional, gentle, and attentive, Miro was calm and the result is simply impeccable.
I recommend her without hesitation!!! 🤩❤️ Thank you so much!
Excellent service !

Capitaine, our 7-month-old Border Terrier, had his first grooming session, and we couldn't have asked for anything better! Amy was remarkably patient and gentle. She explained everything, reassured Capitaine, and the final result is impeccable. You can tell she truly loves animals and is a true professional. Thank you again for this wonderful experience—we'll definitely be back!

My two Siberian cats were groomed perfectly!

She takes her time. Very gentle and meticulous. She gave excellent advice. The price was reasonable.

The salon is very secure. The door is locked, allowing my cats and me to be in a calming environment, without the risk of another client, dog, or third party entering. So there's no risk of escape, theft, fights, or anything else… Plus, it's very clean.
We just left Amy's place!!! Her work is perfect!!! Go there without hesitation, really!!! Thank you so much again for your work and your kindness.

Absolutely fantastic! Amy is a delightful person, incredibly attentive to the dogs she cares for. She only takes one dog at a time and makes them look magnificent!

I would definitely recommend her, but the waiting lists for appointments are already very long, and I probably shouldn't give her too much publicity...

Amy is a fantastic groomer:
Smiling, energetic, professional, and experienced.

Her movements are precise and firm, yet extremely careful.
Our Maine Coon spent a month with my family while we were traveling, and he had accumulated large mats under his belly and armpits. Amy was able to untangle some of them and shave the tougher ones, all while preserving as much of his fur as possible.

Bonus: English and Mandarin speakers: she speaks your language!

You can go without hesitation 😊
Thank you 🙏🏼

It was my little Arlo's first time being groomed, and I'm so happy!

The first two photos are after grooming, and the last two are before. My Arlo came out looking so clean and gorgeous!!! 😻 Amy was very attentive and knew how to adapt the cut to my dog's breed. She gave me some great advice :) I'll definitely be back! 👍🏻

We had an excellent experience! From the start, Amy asked us what we wanted and requested photos to better understand our expectations. My dog ​​was treated very well at Amy's: she even fell asleep, she was so relaxed and comfortable. The result on our Westie was superb! We loved it and will definitely go back. Thank you so much! 😄 …
The staff did such a great job on my pup. She looks like she sobered up and straightened her life out. 🙃 …

Very sweet, perfect work
A big thank you to Amy ✨
The animals came out looking brand new, Amy is very professional and kind. Thank you!
Always impeccable service for my cat. Thank you so much Amy for taking such good care of him!

Thank you soooo much for an amazing experience. Our mini-golden doodle, Milo, simply loved his haircut. He walked out of Amy’s boutique looking and feeling like a Rockstar….. the best haircut/grooming he received in Paris and we booked our next appointment immediately. Amy is super nice to work with and she genuinely cares for her furry clients. Highly recommend without any hesitation.

It's a real pleasure to entrust our Persian cat to Amy, a true animal lover who deeply cares for her. Nokia always feels safe and secure in her expert hands and always comes back soft, well-groomed, and looking his best. A huge thank you for your gentleness and professionalism!

The best grooming in Paris!

We searched everywhere online—from salons that looked very high-end to more affordable ones—but between the unconvincing photos and mixed reviews, nothing really inspired confidence… until we discovered Amy Grooming.

Amy is extremely kind and professional. We booked an appointment about three weeks in advance. From the very first contact, she asked specific questions about our dogs, which immediately reassured us.

The salon is impeccably clean, welcoming, and completely free of any unpleasant odors.

Amy is very conscientious: she takes the time to listen to our needs, ask questions, and truly respect the dogs' pace and comfort.

The grooming of our two dogs took about four hours. However, I had somewhat "messed them up" trying to cut their fur at home… and despite that, Amy magically fixed everything; our dogs were simply transformed :)

In short, a truly perfect experience, I recommend it 100%!
Amy is a gem! My little Cavalier King Charles Spaniel looked absolutely stunning. Thank you!

This was Milo's first haircut here in Paris, as he used to live in Colombia. I was very nervous because Milo had an accident and lost an eye, which made him very fearful. I was looking for a place where he would be treated with lots of love 💖 and gentleness, and above all, where they would take extra care of his little eye, which is a real treasure for his health.

Amy was an exceptional professional! 🐶✂️ She took the time to reassure Milo and cared for him with great tenderness. I'm thrilled; she exceeded all my expectations! 😍 You can tell she does her work with passion and care. I'm so relieved to know I've finally found my trusted grooming salon for Milo. Thank you so much! 🙏✨

Very kind and non-judgmental. My Ragdoll couldn't stand being brushed, so I had to have her coat clipped because of the many knots and dreadlocks in her undercoat.

Thank you for your professionalism.

What a delightful experience! The dog was groomed with the utmost care, and its owner was thrilled to see her little dog looking so well! Amy is warm and welcoming and always happy to share her thoughts on the animal and her experience with the dog. I highly recommend it!

I came to Amy's for the first time with my little dog Saé, who was very stressed from previous grooming experiences and didn't know what to do. Amy is wonderful. She listens, gives great advice, is calm, and very gentle. I really appreciated being able to stay in the salon while she took care of her.
Thank you, Amy, for your professionalism and kindness.
Excellent haircut for our Havanese. Amy is very attentive, I recommend her 100%!

What kindness and dedication to doing things right from this groomer I discovered in the 15th arrondissement! You know from the moment you walk through the door that your pet is going to be pampered. Go there without hesitation, and open your eyes two and a half hours later when you pick up your furry friend. You'll be won over! Thank you, Amy…
Top 👍🏻 I highly recommend Amy, she's very kind, gentle, and attentive! Thank you, my dwarf chinchilla LiL is delighted 💕 …
Excellent service and a very kind and professional groomer 🥰 Top-notch salon! …

Excellent experience, the person was lovely and very dedicated. Our cat didn't want to leave!

I highly recommend them!

I dropped off my Goldendoodle at Amy's today, and he arrived in better condition than I could have hoped!
He's so beautiful and incredibly soft!

Thank you for your wonderful welcome and highly professional service.

I highly recommend them! 👍👍👍
See you soon!

I entrusted my English Cocker Spaniel to Amy for his very first grooming session, and I'm absolutely delighted!

She was very attentive, professional, and offered great advice. My dog ​​came out beautifully groomed, and the price was well worth the quality of service.
I'll definitely be back!
Thank you, Amy! 🐶🐾
Very professional, my cocker spaniel Muffin was beautifully groomed, and Amy is lovely to boot. But you need to book an appointment well in advance because Amy is very booked up.

The best groomer in Paris!

I highly recommend Amy Grooming, without a doubt the best groomer in Paris! I entrusted my long-haired Shiba Inu to her, and the result was simply perfect. My dog ​​came out looking magnificent, with a shiny and well-groomed coat.

Amy is not only extremely professional, but also super friendly, attentive, and caring with animals. You can tell she loves her job and takes care of each little client with love. My Shiba was calm and happy, which speaks volumes about Amy's gentleness and kindness.

If you're looking for a trustworthy groomer in Paris, look no further, Amy Grooming is the one for you. Thank you again for this impeccable work! See you soon for another appointment.

Perfect job on our golden cocker spaniel!

We were worried it would ruin his beautiful coat, but in the end, the result is lovely and much cleaner than before :)

We entrusted our cocker spaniel, Tara, to Amy and we couldn't be happier! The service was simply perfect: Tara came out impeccably groomed, soft and smooth, and visibly relaxed. You can tell that Amy is both skilled and passionate about what she does. We were so delighted that we've already booked another appointment. Thank you again for this exceptional work; we highly recommend her!

Excellent service and fair prices!
The owner loves animals. Highly recommended!
I brought my 7 month old puppy for his first haircut and loved the results. Amy was very nice and my puppy was very happy with her as well. I would definitely recommend her services!!
I highly recommend her; she's gentle, takes her time, is professional and passionate, a superb discovery, thank you Amy ❤️
For a first attempt, it was a resounding success!! My border terrier looks magnificent and is so happy! The grooming was beautiful. We are delighted. Thank you so much.
Officially Tiki's new groomer! 👍🏼 Thank you for him 🐶🦴🐾 …

We brought our puppy, Bamby, to Amy Toilettage for his first grooming, and we're very satisfied with Amy's service. She's patient and did a good job. She also gave us good advice. We will definitely go back to Amy for Bamby's next grooming.
Thank you so much for your professionalism and kindness. It's not easy to find a cat groomer, this was perfect.

Amy is the best groomer in Paris.
My partner and I searched for a long time for a top-notch groomer for our young Border Terrier.
Amy was so gentle with our little Chewie. So kind that he even fell asleep during his grooming session! It was a truly relaxing experience for our Border Terrier, who received a perfect grooming, a pampering bath, and playtime.
Thank you, Amy, and see you soon!
I traveled quite a distance with my Angora rabbit to meet Amy, who was very kind and gentle. She is very professional in her work!

Exquisite craftsmanship, meticulous work. Milka looks more beautiful than ever.
Thank you!
